title: Washed Ashore
hook: Vanessa, soaked and furious, accuses Leo before he has even lifted his face out of the sand.

cliffhanger.beat: The bilge-pump alarm was switched off by hand.

caption: Part 1/10. They blamed the mechanic. The mechanic found the switch. #CoralKey #SurvivalDrama #Castaway #MiniSeries
recap: The yacht sinks in a storm; Vanessa blames Leo, claims the only tarp and makes herself leader, and Priya's bark rules make Leo the camp's servant. Exiled to the rocky point, Leo salvages the wreck and builds a dry sail shelter while the tarp camp floods. Vanessa orders him to swap; he tells her to ask nicely. That night in the flooded engine room he finds the bilge-pump alarm switched off by hand.

scenes.light: low warm sun from frame left, soft fill bouncing off the wet sand
scenes.change: Leo wakes up already blamed for the sinking.

shots.angle: low angle, looking up at her
shots.action: Vanessa, soaked, white blazer torn, white sunglasses crooked on her head, jabs a finger down toward the sand, shaking with anger.
shots.eyeline: Vanessa looks down toward frame right

line.speaker: vanessa
line.text: You sank my yacht, Leo! Say it out loud!

shots.angle: high angle over Vanessa's shoulder, her shoulder soft in the foreground on frame left
shots.action: Leo, face-down in the wet sand, lifts his head, spits out a mouthful of sand and props himself on one elbow, deadpan.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks up toward frame left at Vanessa

line.speaker: leo
line.text: I'm alive, thanks for asking. Anyone else?

shots.action: Priya wrings sea water out of her ponytail, pushes her round glasses up her nose and raises one eyebrow.
shots.eyeline: Priya looks toward frame right, past the camera, at Leo

line.speaker: priya
line.text: Let the record show he didn't deny it.

shots.action: Leo, sand on his cheek, closes his eyes for a long beat and exhales through his nose. He says nothing.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks toward frame left

shots.action: Vanessa climbs onto a washed-up log and raises both arms like a CEO on a stage. The others stand below her on the sand, small against the beach, the yacht tilted on the reef behind them.
shots.eyeline: everyone looks up at Vanessa

line.speaker: vanessa
line.text: Nobody panic. I'm in charge now. Obviously.

shots.action: Jade, in her neon-green sports top, puts her hands on her hips and tilts her head with a mocking grin.
shots.eyeline: Jade looks up toward frame left at Vanessa on the log

line.speaker: jade
line.text: Since when? Who voted?

scenes.light: high bright sun from frame left, hard shadows
scenes.change: Vanessa takes the only shelter and leaves Leo out.

shots.action: Two hands with gold rings yank a bright blue tarp out of a tangle of splintered deck boards and rope.
Vanessa hugs the folded blue tarp to her chest like a trophy and lifts her chin.
shots.eyeline: Vanessa looks toward frame right at the others

line.speaker: vanessa
line.text: This tarp is mine. Leadership has privileges.

shots.action: Mia, hoodie sleeves pulled over her hands, glances at the tarp and then at the others, uneasy.
shots.eyeline: Mia looks toward frame left at Vanessa

line.speaker: mia
line.text: There's only one tarp? For five people?

shots.angle: from behind Vanessa, her shoulder and blonde bob soft on frame left
shots.action: Leo faces the camera on frame right, calm and unimpressed, arms folded.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks toward frame left at Vanessa

line.speaker: leo
line.text: And where am I supposed to sleep?

shots.angle: from behind Leo, his shoulder soft on frame right
shots.action: Vanessa flips her white sunglasses down over her eyes and points far down the beach, off frame left.
shots.eyeline: Vanessa looks toward frame right at Leo

line.speaker: vanessa
line.text: Not my department. Try the rocks, mechanic.

scenes.light: dappled sun through palm leaves from above
scenes.change: The camp makes Leo its servant, and Mia quietly breaks ranks.

shots.action: Priya finishes scratching charcoal marks on the bark strip pinned to the palm, turns and holds the charcoal out toward Leo.
shots.eyeline: Priya looks toward frame right at Leo

line.speaker: priya
line.text: Rule one: Leo fetches. Everyone else rests. Initial here.

shots.action: Leo looks at the bark, then at the charcoal, and gives a tiny tired smile.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks toward frame left

line.speaker: leo
line.text: Great. They brought a lawyer.

shots.action: Jade stretches out on the sand, sweatband on her wrist, grinning up at Leo.
shots.eyeline: Jade looks up toward frame right

line.speaker: jade
line.text: Careful, mechanic. Don't sink the island too.

shots.action: Mia checks over her shoulder that nobody is watching, then presses a green coconut into Leo's hands; only his hands and shoulder are in frame on the right.
shots.eyeline: Mia looks toward frame right at Leo, then down

line.speaker: mia
line.text: Sorry. Here, take this.

shots.angle: eye level, camera walking backwards in front of him
shots.action: Leo walks toward the camera along the beach, coconut under one arm, the palms and the women small behind him.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks ahead, just past the camera

line.speaker: leo
line.text: Fine. I'll build my own.

shots.action: Jade cups her hands around her mouth and shouts down the beach after him.
shots.eyeline: Jade looks toward frame left, far away

line.speaker: jade
line.text: Goodnight, Rocky!

scenes.light: warm afternoon sun from frame right, sparkling water
scenes.change: Leo turns the wreck into a better shelter than the tarp.

shots.action: Leo wades knee-deep through clear teal water toward the tilted white yacht on the reef.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks at the wreck ahead

shots.action: On the tilted deck Leo pats the broken boom and grins to himself.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks down at the boom

line.speaker: leo
line.text: A wreck is just a warehouse that floats badly.

shots.action: A hand with an orange multitool unscrews a rusted bolt on the boom; it drops into the water.
On the windy rocky point Leo pulls a rope knot tight on an A-frame made from the boom, the white sail snapping in the wind.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks at the knot in his hands

line.speaker: leo
line.text: Boom for the frame. Sail for the roof.

shots.action: The finished sail shelter stands taut on the rocks; Leo slaps the frame twice and it doesn't move.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks at the shelter

line.speaker: leo
line.text: Lashings. Done.

scenes.light: blue dusk light, warm lantern glow far away on frame right
scenes.change: The tarp camp floods and has to look at Leo's dry shelter.

shots.action: The blue tarp sags, then collapses; a sheet of rain water pours onto Jade's face.
shots.eyeline: Jade looks up at the tarp

line.speaker: jade
line.text: Why is my face wet?!

shots.action: Vanessa, hair plastered to her face, water dripping off her nose, tries to stay composed.
shots.eyeline: Vanessa looks toward frame right

line.speaker: vanessa
line.text: Nobody panic! I said nobody panic!

shots.action: Priya and Mia stand in the drizzle, staring down the beach at a warm glowing shelter on the rocks.
shots.eyeline: both look toward frame right, far away

line.speaker: priya
line.text: Section four says shelter must be dry. Whose is dry?

shots.action: Mia, rain on her cheeks, gives a small hidden smile.
shots.eyeline: Mia looks toward frame right, far away

line.speaker: mia
line.text: His.

scenes.light: warm lantern light inside the shelter, cold blue rain outside
scenes.change: Vanessa demands the shelter; Leo doesn't budge.

shots.action: Vanessa, dripping and rigid, points at the dry floor inside the shelter.
shots.eyeline: Vanessa looks down toward frame right at Leo

line.speaker: vanessa
line.text: Swap shelters. That's an order.

shots.action: Leo, dry and relaxed, doesn't move; lantern light on his face.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks up toward frame left at Vanessa

line.speaker: leo
line.text: Ask nicely. Then we'll talk.

scenes.change: Leo finds out the sinking wasn't his fault.

shots.action: Leo wades through shin-deep black water, his flashlight beam sweeping across the rusted engine and stopping on the alarm panel.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks at the panel on frame left

line.speaker: leo
line.text: Alarm panel's still wired. Why didn't it scream?

shots.action: A bilge-pump alarm toggle switch set to OFF, wires intact; a thumb brushes it in the flashlight beam.
Leo's face in the flashlight glow, his expression shifting from confusion to cold realisation.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks down at the switch

line.speaker: leo
line.text: The alarm didn't fail. Someone switched it off.

shots.move: fast push in, then hard cut to black
shots.action: Leo's eyes lift from the switch and stare into the dark.
shots.eyeline: Leo looks toward frame left into the dark

line.speaker: leo
line.text: By hand.
